title: CMGNet-SPrompt: a deep learning framework for quinolone scaffold detection in cosmetics via 13C NMR spectroscopy
description:
Reference implementation of CMGNet-SPrompt, a conditional molecular generator (BART/CMGNet) combined with a CReSS/XGBoost scaffold gate for detecting the 4-oxo-1,4-dihydroquinoline-3-carboxylic-acid core from pure 13C NMR peak lists.

This record contains the training and inference code, the processed data splits and manifests, the evaluation and figure-generation scripts, the shipped prediction outputs, and the reported model checkpoints.

Licence. Original code and the trained weights are released under the Apache License 2.0. Third-party components and datasets keep their original licences; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md in the archive.

Data. The synthetic corpus includes LOTUS v9 structures with ACD/Labs-predicted 13C shifts, published under CC BY 4.0 (Nuzillard & Kuhn, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.8175939), plus records from multi, napacd and pnmrnp2 whose redistribution terms are being confirmed. The external test set is released with per-record provenance; the data record contains either the full corpus or the cleared subset plus per-source record indices. See the Data Availability Statement in the manuscript.
notes: The ACD/Lotus-derived records are redistributed under CC BY 4.0 with attribution (Nuzillard & Kuhn, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.8175939). Records from multi/napacd/pnmrnp2 are included only if their terms permit redistribution; otherwise the data record contains the cleared subset plus per-source record indices. ACD/Labs prediction software is commercial and is not distributed.
